sentences.text: (Sl. No. 56)

Court No. - 79
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 13458 of 2024

Applicant :- Smt Damini Shishodia
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Saurabh Chaturvedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard Shri Saurabh Chaturvedi, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Kamlesh Kumar Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. On 22.5.2024, this Court has passed the following order:
"1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Padmakar Rai, learned AGA for the State.
2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to direct the learned A.C.J.M.,
2nd, Gautam Buddh Nagar to decide the Case No.2703 of 2020 (Damini Shishodia Smt Damini Shishodia vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23103299/
1 Vs. Saurav Kumar and others),

entities.text: Damini Shishodia Smt Damini Shishodia vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: u/s 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Dadri, District-Gautambudhnagar, within stipulated time.

3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that coordinate Bench of this court in Application u/s 482 No.22125 of 2023 directed the court below to conclude the proceeding of the aforesaid case, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months, vide order dated 22.06.2023 but the learned court below has not concluded the proceeding.

4. In view of the above, learned A.C.J.M., 2nd, Gautam Buddh Nagar is directed to submit his report why the proceeding of the aforesaid case has not been concluded despite the direction of this court in Application u/s 482 No.22125 of 2023.

5. Put up in the week commencing 08.07.2024 as fresh.
6.

Registrar (Compliance) is directed to intimate this order through e-mail to the concerned court for getting his explanation, before the next date of listing."
3.

In compliance of the above order of this Court, an explanation has been submitted by the A.C.J.M.
II Gautambudh Nagar explaining the circumstances due to which the matter could not be disposed of within the period expected vide order dated 22.6.2023 of this Court passed in Application U/s 482 No. 22125 of 2023.
It is stated by the A.C.J.M. II in the explanation that he has taken the charge on 16.4.2024 and he has explained that the matter was fixed for framing the charge on 29.3.2024.
However, since the opposite party no 2 was not present, the charges could not be framed on 29.3.2024 and thereafter the next dates were fixed on 19.4.2024 and 3.5.2024.
On 3.5.2024 the Presiding Officer was absent due to some emergency.
Thereafter the matter was fixed for 15.5.2024 and on that date the discharge application has been moved by the opposite party no. 2, in which the next date has been fixed as 24.5.2024.
Thereafter on 24.5.2024 some additional documents were filed by the learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.
Then on 19.6.2024 the discharge application has been disposed of.
It is further stated in the explanation that sincere efforts are being made for compliance of the order of this court to dispose of the case expeditiously.

In view thereof, the instant application is disposed of with an expectation that the proceedings of the Case No. 2703 of 2020 (Damini Shishodia Vs. Saurav Kumar and others) under section 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry prohibition Act, police station Dadri District Gautambudh Nagar pending in the Court A.C.J.M. II, Gautam Budh Nagar shall be concluded expeditiously preferably within a further period of six months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 o.k.
(Anish Kumar Gupta, J) 
Smt Damini Shishodia vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23103299/
